name: Learning to Ride
summary: Velma Warnam offers to teach you skeletal riding in exchange for a fee. Her training lets you receive a mount from Zachariah and ride the steeds kept in Brill.

sections.title: A New Skill
sections.body: Once Velma Warnam has trained you, Zachariah can provide a mount at no cost. Additional mounts are available for purchase. Other creatures require their own riding skills, taught by trainers you will need to find.

sections.title: Brill's Steeds
sections.body: After your training, Velma's knowledge of skeletal horses leaves you ready to ride the steeds in Brill. The instruction begins when you have enough coin to pay her.

faq.answer: Velma Warnam offers to teach you how to ride skeletal horses for a fee.

faq.q: Where can I learn to ride skeletal horses?
faq.answer: Velma Warnam teaches skeletal riding in Brill.

faq.q: Who gives me a mount after training?
faq.answer: Zachariah provides you with a mount after you train with Velma Warnam.

faq.q: Do other creatures need different riding skills?
faq.answer: Yes. Each kind of creature requires its own riding skill, and you will need to find its trainer.

faq.q: Do I have to pay Velma?
faq.answer: Velma teaches you for a fee, and asks you to speak with her when you have enough coin.
